name: SIAI-Marchetti SM.1019
summary: Italian turboprop conversion of the Cessna O-1 Bird Dog with an Allison 250 turbine, a long pointed nose and a new tail, built for the Italian Army and now owned privately by a few US pilots.

wings: High, strut-braced wing with big flaps
Hardpoints under the wing on military examples
engines: Single Allison 250 turboprop with a long, pointed nose and a three-blade propeller
Exhaust stacks on each side of the nose
fuselage: Bird Dog-style tandem cabin with huge glazing
Spring-steel main gear legs on a tailwheel layout
tail: Revised tall, squared tail with a dorsal fin

tellTales: Bird Dog silhouette with a long turbine nose and a three-blade propeller
Tandem high-wing with huge side windows and a long snout
Exhaust stacks on the nose of a small spotter airplane

confusedWith.howToTell: The Bird Dog has a short stubby piston cowl and a two-blade propeller; the SM.1019 has a long turbine nose and a new tail.
The L-5 has a smooth piston cowl and rounded tail; the SM.1019 has a long turbine nose and a squared tail.
The Super Cub has a short piston nose and a rounded tail; the SM.1019 has a long turboprop nose and a bigger airframe.
